body:
The proposed AI data center at Drax Power Station in North Yorkshire is the first investment from the $20 billion AI infrastructure venture between Brookfield and Qai, the AI company of the Qatar Investment Authority, Semafor reported on Friday [[1]](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/06/2026/qai-and-brookfield-back-supersized-uk-data-center). The 1-gigawatt campus could become the UK's largest data center, and the partners plan to invest about $3.4 billion over the next five years, Semafor said, citing Bloomberg [[1]](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/06/2026/qai-and-brookfield-back-supersized-uk-data-center).

Drax, Brookfield and Brookfield's UK compute platform Radiant announced the project on Nov. 3, with total investment that Brookfield estimates could exceed £20 billion (MLQ coverage). An initial £2.5 billion is earmarked for a 100 MW first phase scheduled to start operating in the first quarter of 2028, with capacity expected to reach 500 MW between 2028 and 2031 on the 1,000-acre site [[2]](https://realassets.ipe.com/news/brookfield-qia-and-drax-to-build-20bn-northern-england-data-centre-project/10139209.article). Qai chairman Abdulla Al-Misnad called it "a major initiative under the Brookfield-Qai joint venture" [[2]](https://realassets.ipe.com/news/brookfield-qia-and-drax-to-build-20bn-northern-england-data-centre-project/10139209.article).

The site already has a power connection, but the project still requires a green light to begin construction, an anchor tenant and government approvals, according to sovereign-fund consultancy Global SWF [[1]](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/06/2026/qai-and-brookfield-back-supersized-uk-data-center). Drax chief executive Will Gardiner called the station "one of the few UK sites that can provide large-scale reliable power directly to data centre customers" [[2]](https://realassets.ipe.com/news/brookfield-qia-and-drax-to-build-20bn-northern-england-data-centre-project/10139209.article).

Global SWF described Qai's model, partnering with Brookfield to develop computing assets, as one of several Gulf approaches: Abu Dhabi's MGX deploys outside institutional capital, while Saudi Arabia's HUMAIN pairs AI operations with investments [[1]](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/06/2026/qai-and-brookfield-back-supersized-uk-data-center). Brookfield launched its wider AI infrastructure strategy, which targets up to $100 billion across energy, land, data centers and compute, in November 2025 with Nvidia and the Kuwait Investment Authority [[2]](https://realassets.ipe.com/news/brookfield-qia-and-drax-to-build-20bn-northern-england-data-centre-project/10139209.article).

p: Semafor는 금요일, 노스요크셔 Drax Power Station에 추진 중인 AI 데이터센터가 Brookfield와 카타르투자청(Qatar Investment Authority)의 AI 기업 Qai가 조성한 200억 달러 규모 AI 인프라 벤처의 첫 투자라고 보도했다 [[1]](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/06/2026/qai-and-brookfield-back-supersized-uk-data-center). Semafor는 Bloomberg를 인용해 1기가와트(GW) 규모의 이 캠퍼스가 영국 최대 데이터센터가 될 수 있으며, 파트너들이 향후 5년간 약 34억 달러를 투자할 계획이라고 전했다 [[1]](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/06/2026/qai-and-brookfield-back-supersized-uk-data-center).

Drax, Brookfield, 그리고 Brookfield의 영국 컴퓨트 플랫폼 Radiant는 11월 3일 이 프로젝트를 발표했으며, Brookfield는 총 투자 규모가 200억 파운드를 넘어설 수 있다고 추산한다(MLQ 보도). 우선 25억 파운드가 100MW 규모의 1단계에 배정돼 있으며, 1단계는 2028년 1분기 가동을 시작할 예정이다. 1,000에이커 부지의 용량은 2028년부터 2031년 사이 500MW까지 늘어날 것으로 예상된다 [[2]](https://realassets.ipe.com/news/brookfield-qia-and-drax-to-build-20bn-northern-england-data-centre-project/10139209.article). Qai 회장 Abdulla Al-Misnad는 이를 "Brookfield-Qai 합작 벤처의 주요 이니셔티브"라고 불렀다 [[2]](https://realassets.ipe.com/news/brookfield-qia-and-drax-to-build-20bn-northern-england-data-centre-project/10139209.article).

국부펀드 컨설팅사 Global SWF에 따르면 이 부지는 이미 전력 연결이 확보돼 있으나, 프로젝트는 착공 승인, 앵커 테넌트 확보, 정부 인허가를 아직 필요로 한다 [[1]](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/06/2026/qai-and-brookfield-back-supersized-uk-data-center). Drax 최고경영자(CEO) Will Gardiner는 이 발전소를 "데이터센터 고객에게 대규모 안정 전력을 직접 공급할 수 있는 영국 내 몇 안 되는 부지 중 하나"라고 말했다 [[2]](https://realassets.ipe.com/news/brookfield-qia-and-drax-to-build-20bn-northern-england-data-centre-project/10139209.article).

Global SWF는 Brookfield와 손잡고 컴퓨팅 자산을 개발하는 Qai의 모델을 여러 걸프 지역 접근법 중 하나로 설명했다. 아부다비의 MGX는 외부 기관 자본을 투입하고, 사우디아라비아의 HUMAIN은 AI 운영과 투자를 결합한다 [[1]](https://www.semafor.com/article/11/06/2026/qai-and-brookfield-back-supersized-uk-data-center). 에너지·부지·데이터센터·컴퓨트 전반에 최대 1,000억 달러를 투자하는 것을 목표로 하는 Brookfield의 더 넓은 AI 인프라 전략은 2025년 11월 Nvidia, Kuwait Investment Authority와 함께 출범했다 [[2]](https://realassets.ipe.com/news/brookfield-qia-and-drax-to-build-20bn-northern-england-data-centre-project/10139209.article).
중요한 기사만 이메일 한 통에. 무료이며 언제든 구독을 취소할 수 있습니다.
